subject: Re: Launch pricing — flexible commit, launch cushion & credits
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@voltlaunch.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Launch pricing — flexible commit, launch cushion & credits

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the chat earlier. VoltLaunch is planning a staged public launch for our new recommendations product in November. We expect a heavy ramp over the first three months: approximate tokens by month: Nov ~120M, Dec ~220M, Jan ~420M (peak). There will be pronounced weekly spikes for Black Friday style promos.

We're evaluating two things and would appreciate a concrete proposal:
- A monthly commit staircase (step-up commits) that matches the expected ramp but leaves room for sudden spikes (launch cushion).
- A short-term launch credit / surcharge protection for the first 60 days to avoid sharp overage billing while we tune prompts and caching.

Can you outline a per-token pricing schedule for committed volumes, overage rates, and how you typically structure a launch cushion (one-time credit vs. temporary reduced overage)? Also curious if embeddings usage should be in the same commit or billed separately.

Attached is a rough forecast (VoltLaunch_MonthlyForecast_Q4.xlsx). Happy to join a call with AdOps if that helps.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Product Lead — Recommendations
VoltLaunch

[attachment: VoltLaunch_MonthlyForecast_Q4.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@voltlaunch.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Launch pricing — flexible commit, launch cushion & credits

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear forecast and the call earlier.

High level proposal (quick summary):
- Commit structure: monthly committed token buckets with step-up windows. We propose a 3-month staged commit: 150M / 250M / 400M (months 1–3).
- Discounts: committed rate is 18% off on-host per-token list for the 3-month commit (applies only to text gen tokens).
- Launch cushion: 1) an up-front launch credit equal to 10% of month 1 committed spend OR 2) a temporary reduced overage rate for months 1–2 (choose one). Our recommended default is the reduced overage (50% of standard overage) — simpler operationally.
- Overage billing: billed at overage rate (committed rate + 40% premium) after cushion.
- True-up: monthly true-up with ability to convert sustained overage into next-month commit tiers (pro-rata).
- Embeddings: recommended to keep embeddings on a separate commit/line item — different token shapes and cost profile. We can provide a separate tier (suggested 20% discount on embedding units with a small minimum).

I attached a short proposal PDF (RL-proposal-VL-DL-2026-0891.pdf) with a sample cost table and the alternate credit vs reduced overage math. If you're ok, I'll loop Aditya and Marissa to align signals for finance and legal (procurement) and prepare a DocuSign for the chosen path.

Proposed next step: 30-minute pricing alignment next week (I'm available Tue/Wed).

— Hannah
Head of Sales, Platform
Redwood Inference

[attachment: RL-proposal-VL-DL-2026-0891.pdf (proposal PDF)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@voltlaunch.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 08:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Launch pricing — flexible commit, launch cushion & credits

Looping in a couple internal notes from pricing ops:
- Billing alignment: VoltLaunch should confirm whether they want commits invoiced monthly (recommended) or as a single up-front prepay. Monthly invoicing keeps flexibility for step-ups.
- Recommendation: Offer the reduced-overage approach for months 1–2 and a 10% one-time launch credit applied to month 1 billing as a goodwill signal (if they choose the reduced-overage we can still expose the 10% credit as an alternative).
- Suggested contractual language: explicit carve-out for promotional bursts (e.g., marketing campaign days) up to +35% of committed volume per month, beyond which normal overage applies. This protects both parties.
- Embeddings note: we price embeddings per-embedding-unit; keep it split in contract to avoid cross-subsidizing.

Marissa — can you confirm finance okays the 10% goodwill credit (one-time) and the 35% burst carve-out? If yes, I'll draft the commercial term sheet and an initial HubSpot quote (DL-2026-0891).

Thanks,
Aditya
Pricing & Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@voltlaunch.com>

Subject: Re: Launch pricing — flexible commit, launch cushion & credits

Thanks, Hannah and Aditya. This looks reasonable. A couple clarifying points from procurement: 
- VoltLaunch prefers monthly invoicing.
- We accept the reduced-overage for months 1–2 and would like the 10% month-1 launch credit as well (both if possible) — the credit will help amortize our prompt engineering iterations.
- Can you confirm the timing and process for a month-by-month true-up and the mechanics to convert a sustained overage into a committed step-up mid-quarter? We want to avoid surprise billing windows.
- Embeddings: confirm separate line item and we'll provide an initial estimate next week.

Can we aim to finalize terms and get a DocuSign by 09/06 so we have procurement sign-off before the demo launch on 11/01?

Best,
Sophie

Quick internal confirmation: finance has approved the 10% one-time launch credit and the 35% promotional burst carve-out for this particular deal, subject to:
- A contractual clause limiting the reduced-overage to months 1–2 only.
- A monthly true-up process with automated notices at 80% and 100% of committed volume.
- A manual review trigger if overage exceeds +50% for any month.

Next steps for us:

2) Hannah to schedule a 30-min final alignment call with VoltLaunch (Sophie + procurement) next week.
